entries.780cb394d3265fa2: It has formulated the 'Medium-Term Management Plan 2027' covering the three years from the fiscal year ended December 2025 through the fiscal year ending December 2027, adopts 'Create More Fun and More Fans!' as its slogan, and sets five priority themes: (1) developing and securing people who will create the future; (2) building a fan base for 'Good Ethical Company'; (3) expanding service areas and improving the value it provides; (4) supply chains supporting sustainable growth; and (5) deepening global markets.
